controls.title: Notice at or before collection
controls.requirement: Provide the required notice information in the manner prescribed by the applicable provision/rules.
controls.assessment_question: Is a privacy notice provided at or before the relevant collection interaction?
controls.evidence_expectation: Current privacy notice, form/screen reference, publication/version record.
controls.remediation: Create or update the collection-point privacy notice and record its version/evidence.
controls.effective_date_basis: DPDP Act commencement notification: 18 months from 13 Nov 2025

controls.title: Consent and withdrawal mechanism
controls.requirement: Where processing relies on consent, consent must meet the Act's requirements and withdrawal must be supported as required.
controls.assessment_question: Where consent is the processing basis, is consent captured and can it be withdrawn as required?
controls.evidence_expectation: Consent wording, capture mechanism, consent record/process, withdrawal procedure.
controls.remediation: Document the processing basis and implement/verify consent and withdrawal controls where applicable.
controls.effective_date_basis: DPDP Act commencement notification: 18 months from 13 Nov 2025

controls.title: General security safeguards
controls.requirement: Implement reasonable security safeguards appropriate to protect personal data.
controls.assessment_question: Are appropriate technical and organisational safeguards applied to protect personal data?
controls.evidence_expectation: Encryption/configuration evidence, access control, security policy, monitoring or assessment records.
controls.remediation: Close identified security gaps and document the implemented safeguards.
controls.effective_date_basis: DPDP Act commencement notification: 18 months from 13 Nov 2025

controls.title: Children's personal data
controls.requirement: Apply the additional statutory requirements relevant to processing children's personal data.
controls.assessment_question: Does this process involve children, and have the additional requirements been addressed?
controls.evidence_expectation: Age/parental consent mechanism where applicable, notice, process documentation and control evidence.
controls.remediation: Identify child-data processing and implement the applicable enhanced controls.
controls.effective_date_basis: DPDP Act commencement notification: 18 months from 13 Nov 2025

controls.title: Retention and deletion governance
controls.requirement: Organisations should operationalise retention/deletion requirements applicable to their processing.
controls.assessment_question: Is retention defined and is deletion/erasure operationally controlled when required?
controls.evidence_expectation: Retention schedule, deletion procedure, system configuration or disposal record.
controls.remediation: Define retention triggers and implement deletion/erasure controls.
controls.effective_date_basis: DPDP Act commencement notification: 18 months from 13 Nov 2025

controls.title: Data Principal rights and grievance process
controls.requirement: Support applicable rights and grievance redressal mechanisms.
controls.assessment_question: Is there a documented mechanism for applicable rights requests and grievance redressal?
controls.evidence_expectation: Published contact/process, workflow, SLA/owner and records.
controls.remediation: Document and test the rights/grievance intake and response workflow.
controls.effective_date_basis: DPDP Act commencement notification: 18 months from 13 Nov 2025
